# TypeScript language fact extraction

This file implements a deterministic plugin for analyzing TypeScript source code to emit semantic facts about modules, symbols, dependencies, routing, and tests. It mirrors the vocabulary of the Python analyzer, enabling downstream processes to remain language-agnostic. The analyzer processes TypeScript files, extracts structural and routing information, tracks dependencies (with special handling for tsconfig path aliases), and detects test cases and API endpoints.
